hypothesis: A temporal convolution that predicts only the residual over an observed-only contextual Hermite/quaternion curve can learn motion-specific corrections without first relearning the established procedural curve.

architecture.baseline: Observed-only per-joint contextual position curve and aligned normalized-quaternion curve; exactly linear/SLERP when only two boundary poses exist.
architecture.learned_component: Noncausal six-block residual temporal convolution, width 128, dilations 1,2,4,8,16,32, 153 outputs.
architecture.authored_values: Residual is zeroed at all position/orientation masks and observations are restored after inference.
architecture.initialization: Zero output layer makes the first proposal exactly the procedural ablation.
architecture.scope: Research only. No addon registration, shipped weights or parity claim.

data.transformation: Replace only baseline channels 0:153 and the separate baseline array with the observed-only shape curve. Preserve observed channels, masks, rest/timing features, targets, dt, splits and sampling.

training.loss: unknown position MSE + 0.1 rotation6 MSE + 0.01 velocity MSE + 0.0001 acceleration MSE; derivatives use actual seconds and known observations remain excluded
training.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final epoch only; no development checkpoint selection

prospective_evaluation.required_ablation: observed_shape_ablation built by the same conditioning module as the learned proposal
prospective_evaluation.attribution_gate: Each learned seed must improve position over its exact procedural ablation and pass every pre-existing position, rotation, velocity, acceleration, edge-length, endpoint and cohort gate on all three partitions.
prospective_evaluation.confirmation: Protected confirmation clips remain sealed unless both fixed seeds pass all development gates.
